answer: Each identity must finish a sequential kernel proof: a verifiable delay function seeded by epoch hash and its public key, taking T minutes of single-thread compute that cannot be parallelized or shared. N fakes cost N*T machine-minutes in a fixed epoch window W, so each fake past floor(W/T) forces buying another machine: total cost grows super-linearly in N. The output must travel as a signed whisper through juniper relays charging congestion fees, so each clone pays a rising relay fee too. Forged kernels fail the key check and burn the whisper bond.
